verdict.rationale: Capacities documents a REST API that lets you access, create and manipulate content with Bearer-token auth (capacities-docs-33, capacities-docs-18). That API has a published OpenAPI 3.0 spec and an interactive try-it reference (capacities-supp-openapi, capacities-supp-interactive-reference). It also has an official MCP server and chat connectors for agents like Claude and Cursor (capacities-probe-3, capacities-docs-17, capacities-docs-3), so an agent can read and write notes without the GUI. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agent read/write workflows, explicit documentation of write scope via the MCP server, and stability, since the Beta API is deprecated on Sept 1, 2026 in favor of a new portal (capacities-supp-beta-deprecation).
